info.title: PISA contract 2: /v2/live
info.description: The live socket between a PISA server and the PISA app (or any headless client). One JSON object per text frame. Server event frames carry plain AG-UI 1.0 events (each must also validate against the official AG-UI 1.0 schema), multiplexed one AG-UI stream per threadId; pisa.* server events are AG-UI CUSTOM events. Generated from schema/pisa-contract-2.schema.json by tools/gen_asyncapi.py: do not edit.

pisa.description: The user's own PISA server. TLS 1.3, pinned to the SPKI from pairing (CONTRACT-2 §3.1, §4.3).

host.description: host[:port] of the server, from the pairing QR or pisa.endpoints.

live.title: The live socket
live.description: WebSocket, subprotocol pisa.v2. The app sends hello first; the server answers welcome with what it picked, and never sends what was not negotiated. Close codes 1000, 1002, 1011, 4001, 4003, 4008.

hello.name: hello
hello.title: hello
hello.summary: Client -> server, the first frame on /v2/live.

run.name: run
run.title: run
run.summary: Start a run (a turn, or a resume). input is an AG-UI 1.0 RunAgentInput; forwardedProps.pisa carries the turn's device facts (TurnProps).

cancel.name: cancel
cancel.title: cancel
cancel.summary: Stop a run: the server ends it with the cancelled outcome and sends nothing more for it (barge-in).

a2ui.name: a2ui
a2ui.title: a2ui
a2ui.summary: An A2UI renderer->agent message (action or error), exactly as A2UI 1.0 defines it.

custom.name: custom
custom.title: custom
custom.summary: A client pisa.* event; see the custom.* messages for each name.

custom.pisa_presence.name: custom.pisa_presence
custom.pisa_presence.title: pisa.presence
custom.pisa_presence.summary: Where the user can be reached. Sent on change and right after welcome.

custom.pisa_surface_ack.name: custom.pisa_surface_ack
custom.pisa_surface_ack.title: pisa.surface.ack
custom.pisa_surface_ack.summary: Replaces presented. Sent at once for every a2ui-surface or mcp-apps activity.

custom.pisa_surface_event.name: custom.pisa_surface_event
custom.pisa_surface_event.title: pisa.surface.event
custom.pisa_surface_event.summary: Ids only: never gaze, never content.

custom.pisa_voice_partial.name: custom.pisa_voice_partial
custom.pisa_voice_partial.title: pisa.voice.partial
custom.pisa_voice_partial.summary: A partial transcript (at most 2 a second while listening), only after welcome granted pisa.voice.turn_hints. Never stored.

custom.pisa_voice_talk_text.name: custom.pisa_voice_talk_text
custom.pisa_voice_talk_text.title: pisa.voice.talk.text
custom.pisa_voice_talk_text.summary: Contract 2.1, the feature talk.text (pisa.voice): words the user typed into this device's open talk; id is the talk's session_id (POST /v1/talk/sessions). The server gives them to the talker as the user's text turn and Pisa answers by voice; they come back as the user's final pisa.voice.transcript on the talk's channel (their bubble, in the talk's run) and are stored as their message. Refused with a control error: invalid_frame for an id that is not this device's open talk or text out of bounds (1-4000 characters, as a typed turn), ai_consent_required without the user's AI consent. While a talk is open a typed run is answered the same way, never in text only.

custom.pisa_app_result.name: custom.pisa_app_result
custom.pisa_app_result.title: pisa.app.result
custom.pisa_app_result.summary: Contract 2.2, the feature app.actions (pisa.app): the app's answer to pisa.app.open: ok when the screen is open (or the riepilogo read again); else why not (unsupported: this app has no such screen; not_found: no such tab or task; not_now: the app can't move now, e.g. a sheet is open or the phone is locked; error).

custom.pisa_maps_result.name: custom.pisa_maps_result
custom.pisa_maps_result.title: pisa.maps.result
custom.pisa_maps_result.summary: Contract 2.3, the feature maps.phone (pisa.maps): the phone's answer to pisa.maps.search (places, 1-10) or pisa.maps.eta (eta), with ok true; or ok false and why (denied: the user did not allow location or maps; unavailable: the maps service failed or is offline; no_results; timeout: the maps service did not answer in time; unsupported: this client can't). Untrusted input to the server: bounded, quarantined as outside text, never instructions; coordinates are never logged.

custom.pisa_notify_ack.name: custom.pisa_notify_ack
custom.pisa_notify_ack.title: pisa.notify.ack
custom.pisa_notify_ack.summary: Contract 2.3, the feature notify.local (pisa.notify): the phone's report on the frame with this revision: the ids it applied (scheduled, cancelled or watched) and those it could not, with why (denied: notifications or location not allowed; limit: the system's cap on pending notifications or regions; past: fireAt already gone; invalid; unsupported; error). Untrusted input to the server: ids it did not send are ignored.

welcome.name: welcome
welcome.title: welcome
welcome.summary: Server -> client: what the server picked. Everything not picked is never sent.

error.name: error
error.title: error
error.summary: A control error: auth_failed, device_revoked, contract_unsupported, invalid_frame, rate_limited, internal, replaced or ai_consent_required (CONTRACT-2 §3.1, §4.5).

event.name: event
event.title: AG-UI event
event.summary: One AG-UI 1.0 event of the AG-UI stream for threadId (the socket multiplexes one AG-UI stream per thread; each obeys the AG-UI lifecycle on its own). runId is the run the event belongs to. Session-level server events (pisa.notice and the rest) travel in short server-started runs on the thread pisa-notices:<deviceId>. seq grows by one per frame in the session; resume replays after lastSeq.

event.pisa_voice_audio.name: event.pisa_voice_audio
event.pisa_voice_audio.title: pisa.voice.audio
event.pisa_voice_audio.summary: The server's voice for a text message (messageId) or a notice (noticeId), in seq order. Replaces say_audio. A device that negotiated audio.binary gets the same chunk as a binary frame instead.

event.pisa_voice_state.name: event.pisa_voice_state
event.pisa_voice_state.title: pisa.voice.state
event.pisa_voice_state.summary: What the voice is doing (natural mode): drives the presence orb and the Talk Live Activity.

event.pisa_voice_gate.name: event.pisa_voice_gate
event.pisa_voice_gate.title: pisa.voice.gate
event.pisa_voice_gate.summary: G5. During a gated talk (VOICE-ID-1): whose voice the gate hears, at most twice a second (a subtle state on the orb). Replaces talk.gate.

event.pisa_voice_transcript.name: event.pisa_voice_transcript
event.pisa_voice_transcript.title: pisa.voice.transcript
event.pisa_voice_transcript.summary: The user's words as the server heard them (natural mode); text is the whole line so far. A final without ignored becomes a user message in MESSAGES_SNAPSHOT.

event.pisa_voice_turn_hint.name: event.pisa_voice_turn_hint
event.pisa_voice_turn_hint.title: pisa.voice.turn_hint
event.pisa_voice_turn_hint.summary: End-of-turn score for a partial transcript (economy mode).

event.pisa_voice_understood.name: event.pisa_voice_understood
event.pisa_voice_understood.title: pisa.voice.understood
event.pisa_voice_understood.summary: What the server understood the user meant.

event.pisa_notice.name: event.pisa_notice
event.pisa_notice.title: pisa.notice
event.pisa_notice.summary: A proactive notice. The same object is the plaintext of a relay-sealed push (CONTRACT-2 §9). Replaces notify.

event.pisa_ask_to_open.name: event.pisa_ask_to_open
event.pisa_ask_to_open.title: pisa.ask_to_open
event.pisa_ask_to_open.summary: The server asks to open a voice talk (earbuds, glasses, car).

event.pisa_directions.name: event.pisa_directions
event.pisa_directions.title: pisa.directions
event.pisa_directions.summary: Open the maps app (foreground) or a notification that opens it.

event.pisa_call.name: event.pisa_call
event.pisa_call.title: pisa.call
event.pisa_call.summary: Place a phone call after the user's tap (Ring 0 confirms).

event.pisa_compose.name: event.pisa_compose
event.pisa_compose.title: pisa.compose
event.pisa_compose.summary: Open a prepared message; the user sends it.

event.pisa_approval_state.name: event.pisa_approval_state
event.pisa_approval_state.title: pisa.approval.state
event.pisa_approval_state.summary: An approval's interrupt was closed somewhere else (voice, another device, expiry): the app drops the held interrupt and must not resume it.

event.pisa_ai_disclosure.name: event.pisa_ai_disclosure
event.pisa_ai_disclosure.title: pisa.ai.disclosure
event.pisa_ai_disclosure.summary: Which AI providers and models the server sends the user's data to, per slot (guideline 5.1.2(i)). revision = sha256 of the JCS of processors; it changes whenever a provider or model changes, and the app asks again.

event.pisa_endpoints.name: event.pisa_endpoints
event.pisa_endpoints.title: pisa.endpoints
event.pisa_endpoints.summary: The server's reachable addresses and its SPKI pins (current and the pre-announced next key), sent after a change. Authenticated by the pinned channel; the app keeps the set per server.

event.pisa_surface_focus.name: event.pisa_surface_focus
event.pisa_surface_focus.title: pisa.surface.focus
event.pisa_surface_focus.summary: Bring a surface already shown back in front (v1 focus).

event.pisa_entitlement_required.name: event.pisa_entitlement_required
event.pisa_entitlement_required.title: pisa.entitlement.required
event.pisa_entitlement_required.summary: The server offers this feature but the app reported no entitlement for it: the app shows its paywall (Ring 0).

event.pisa_app_open.name: event.pisa_app_open
event.pisa_app_open.title: pisa.app.open
event.pisa_app_open.summary: Contract 2.2, the feature app.actions (pisa.app): Pisa asks the app to open one of its own screens: a tab (id: the tab's id, pisa, oggi or impostazioni), the riepilogo, a task (id: its uuid), Settings → AI e privacy, or to read the riepilogo again (riepilogo_refresh). The app does it and answers with pisa.app.result for the same actionId at once; without an answer in a few seconds Pisa says it isn't confirmed. Never anything outside the app.

event.pisa_app_changed.name: event.pisa_app_changed
event.pisa_app_changed.title: pisa.app.changed
event.pisa_app_changed.summary: Contract 2.2, the feature briefing.view (pisa.app): the user's tasks or agenda changed (on any device, by Pisa or by them), so the views named are out of date: the app reads them again (GET /v1/briefings/latest, GET /v1/plan...). Ids only, never content; at most about once a second.

event.pisa_maps_search.name: event.pisa_maps_search
event.pisa_maps_search.title: pisa.maps.search
event.pisa_maps_search.summary: Contract 2.3, the feature maps.phone (pisa.maps): Pisa asks the phone to look places up with its own maps (no server key), near "here" or a coordinate (absent: wherever the phone's maps search by default), of one kind, at most limit (default 5, at most 10). Sent in the turn's run; the phone answers pisa.maps.result for the same requestId at once. Without an answer in a few seconds Pisa says it couldn't look. The server never logs near's coordinates.

event.pisa_maps_eta.name: event.pisa_maps_eta
event.pisa_maps_eta.title: pisa.maps.eta
event.pisa_maps_eta.summary: Contract 2.3, the feature maps.phone (pisa.maps): Pisa asks the phone how long it takes from one point to another by mode (walk, transit, drive, bike, as pisa.directions) with its own maps; each point is "here", a coordinate or a placeId from an earlier result. The phone answers pisa.maps.result for the same requestId with eta. The server never logs the coordinates.

event.pisa_notify_schedule.name: event.pisa_notify_schedule
event.pisa_notify_schedule.title: pisa.notify.schedule
event.pisa_notify_schedule.summary: Contract 2.3, the feature notify.local (pisa.notify): schedule these local notifications on the phone (an item whose id is already scheduled replaces it; ids are unique within the frame), so they fire even with no connection. Sent on the notices thread; the phone answers pisa.notify.ack for the same revision.

event.pisa_notify_cancel.name: event.pisa_notify_cancel
event.pisa_notify_cancel.title: pisa.notify.cancel
event.pisa_notify_cancel.summary: Contract 2.3, the feature notify.local (pisa.notify): remove these scheduled notifications or watched places (an unknown id is no error). The phone answers pisa.notify.ack.

event.pisa_notify_regions.name: event.pisa_notify_regions
event.pisa_notify_regions.title: pisa.notify.regions
event.pisa_notify_regions.summary: Contract 2.3, the feature notify.local (pisa.notify): the whole set of places the phone watches (at most 20, the system's limit); it replaces the previous set, and an empty one stops them all. The phone answers pisa.notify.ack.

sessionToken.description: Short-lived (1 h) session token from POST /v1/devices/session, signed by the device's Secure Enclave key (CONTRACT-2 §4.3).
